pages.text: Performs deploying / item application recipes.$(br2)Right-click a block with an item to apply it. Sneak + right-click highlights blocks — this is also how you assign targets to a maid.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Ctrl + scroll$() cycles modes$(li)$(l)Default$(): highlight / process on right-click$(li)$(l)Mark$(): record a work block, input and output$(li)$(l)Fluid$(): record input basin, output and (optionally) overflow$(br)$(br)Sneak + right-click a maid to apply the marks to her.

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)Telling a maid to only work a block (process-only mode) just needs the work block marked.$(li)The two kinds of marks (work vs fluid) are exclusive — applying one clears the other.
